auxiliary_variables.definition: scalar curvature of g on the constraint set
R_mn[g]-(1/4)g_mn scalar_curvature[g] on the constraint set

metric_derivative_equation.equation: W_g c_mna = F^c_mna := partial_a F^g_mn -(partial_a g^bc)partial_b c_mnc

closed_second_order_system.not_an_order_reduction_of_the_physics: The enlarged system is equivalent to the original fourth-order metric equation only on the complete definition-and-gauge constraint surface.
closed_second_order_system.principal_organization: Each displayed evolution equation has W_g acting on its own unknown; every right-hand side is an exact function of U and partial U after the definitions above are expanded.

scalar_derivative_equation.equation: W_g r_a = F^r_a := partial_a F^R -(partial_a g^bc)partial_b r_c

scalar_equation.coordinate_form: W_g R = F^R := Gamma^a r_a +(c_R R+2c_Lambda)/[2(3alpha+beta)]
scalar_equation.covariant_form: E_R := 2(3 alpha+beta) Box_g R - c_R R - 2 c_Lambda = 0

trace_free_ricci_equation.coordinate_form: W_g S_mn = beta^(-1){(2alpha+beta)(nabla_m r_n)^TF -[c_R+(2alpha+beta/2)R]S_mn -2beta R_mrns[g,c]S^rs +(beta/2)g_mn S_rs S^rs} - L^S_mn
trace_free_ricci_equation.covariant_form: E_S_mn := beta Box_g S_mn -(2 alpha+beta)(nabla_m r_n-(1/4)g_mn Box_g R) +[c_R+(2 alpha+beta/2)R]S_mn +2 beta R_mrns[g,c] S^rs -(beta/2)g_mn S_rs S^rs = 0

coefficient_controls.3alpha_plus_beta_eq_0: E_R cannot be solved as a scalar wave equation; generic reduction rank changes.
coefficient_controls.alpha_eq_beta_eq_0: Einstein second-order control; not in the generic reduction.
coefficient_controls.beta_eq_0: E_S cannot be solved as a wave equation; generic reduction rank changes.
coefficient_controls.c_Lambda: lower order in every principal block
coefficient_controls.c_R_eq_0: Reduction remains algebraically invertible when beta and 3alpha+beta are nonzero, but the sector is not Einstein-connected.

consumed_frozen_conventions.riemann: R^rho_{ sigma mu nu} = partial_mu Gamma^rho_{nu sigma} - partial_nu Gamma^rho_{mu sigma} + Gamma^rho_{mu lambda} Gamma^lambda_{nu sigma} - Gamma^rho_{nu lambda} Gamma^lambda_{mu sigma}

derivative_ledger.constraint_derivative_order: C_H and C_c are first order; C_R and C_S are second order in the metric
C_r is first order in R; C_R is second order in g
C_r and C_curl_r are first order in reduced variables
C_c and C_curl_c are first order in reduced variables
C_trace is algebraic, C_div is first order, and C_S is second order in g

equivalence_boundary.auxiliary_to_metric: A sufficiently regular auxiliary solution satisfying every definition, trace, divergence, integrability, gauge, Hamiltonian, and momentum constraint reconstructs R_mn=S_mn+(1/4)g_mn R; E_R=0 and E_S=0 then reconstruct E_mn=0 by trace plus trace-free decomposition.
equivalence_boundary.metric_to_auxiliary: A C^4 solution g of E_mn=0 in the prescribed generalized-harmonic gauge induces R, r, c, and S by their definitions and satisfies E_g^H, E_R, E_r, E_c, and E_S.
equivalence_boundary.next_required_proof: derive the closed homogeneous gauge and auxiliary-constraint propagation system

exact_operator_definitions.component_wave: W_g u := g^ab partial_a partial_b u, component by component
exact_operator_definitions.generalized_harmonic_remainder: Q^H_mn := Q_mn(g,c) +(1/2)(g_mr partial_n H^r+g_nr partial_m H^r)
exact_operator_definitions.harmonic_ricci_remainder: Q_mn(g,c) := R_mn[g] +(1/2)W_g g_mn -(1/2)(g_mr partial_n Gamma^r +g_nr partial_m Gamma^r); all partial c terms cancel
exact_operator_definitions.riemann: R^r_smn[g,c] := partial_m Gamma^r_ns -partial_n Gamma^r_ms +Gamma^r_ml Gamma^l_ns -Gamma^r_nl Gamma^l_ms
exact_operator_definitions.tensor_box: Box_g S_mn := g^ab D_a D_b S_mn
exact_operator_definitions.tensor_box_remainder: L^S_mn(g,c,partial c,S,partial S) := Box_g S_mn-W_g S_mn
exact_operator_definitions.tensor_first_derivative: D_a S_mn := partial_a S_mn -Gamma^r_am S_rn-Gamma^r_an S_mr
exact_operator_definitions.tensor_second_derivative: D_a D_b S_mn := partial_a(D_b S_mn) -Gamma^r_ab D_r S_mn -Gamma^r_am D_b S_rn -Gamma^r_an D_b S_mr

frozen_scope.gauge_source: H^mu=H^mu(x,g), prescribed C^2, with no dependence on partial g or higher derivatives

definition_derived_fields: r_a and its normal derivative from C_r and E_R
c_mna and its normal derivative from C_c and E_g^H
initial_data_contract.freely_specifiable_component_parametriza: NOT_CLASSIFIED_HERE; solving and parametrizing the coupled constraint manifold belongs to the propagation/initial-data successor and cannot be inferred from raw component counts
not_freely_specifiable_on_metric_equival: R data, which must satisfy C_R
S_mn data, which must satisfy C_S, C_trace, and C_div
g_mn data, which must satisfy gauge, Hamiltonian, and momentum constraints
initial_data_contract.raw_second_order_data: U|Sigma and n^a partial_a U|Sigma for U=(g,R,r,c,S)
unconstrained_seed_fields_before_constra: g_mn and normal derivative of g_mn
R and normal derivative of R
trace-free S_mn and normal derivative of S_mn

original_metric_equation.equation: E_mn := c_R(R_mn-(1/2)g_mn R) -(1/2)c_Lambda g_mn + alpha[2 R R_mn -(1/2)g_mn R^2 +2(g_mn Box_g-nabla_m nabla_n)R] + beta[2 R_mrns R^rs -(1/2)g_mn R_rs R^rs +Box_g R_mn +(1/2)g_mn Box_g R -nabla_m nabla_n R] = 0

projection_derivation.reconstruction_identity: E_mn = E_S_mn+(1/4)g_mn(g^rs E_rs), with g^rs E_rs=E_R
projection_derivation.trace_equation: E_R := 2(3 alpha+beta) Box_g R - c_R R - 2 c_Lambda = 0
projection_derivation.trace_free_equation: E_S_mn := beta Box_g S_mn -(2 alpha+beta)(nabla_m r_n-(1/4)g_mn Box_g R) +[c_R+(2 alpha+beta/2)R]S_mn +2 beta R_mrns[g,c] S^rs -(beta/2)g_mn S_rs S^rs = 0
